description: Welcome to this beautiful 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom home in Spanish Oaks Subdivision. This house features fresh paint and luxury vinyl plank, ceramic tile and carpet throughout. Prepare chef inspired meals in your kitchen equipped with an island that offers additional counter space for meal prep or entertaining, a stainless steel refrigerator, smooth top stove, and solid surface countertops that make clean up a breeze. The rear master bedroom and ensuite provides a quiet retreat, while faux wood blinds add a touch of elegance to the space. Enjoy the privacy of a fenced yard with shade trees. Close to Fort Cavazos, YMCA, Dog Park, shopping, food, and entertainment. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make this house your home!
